description: This file defines an Android activity named SetTimerActivity that allows users to set timers on an Android wearable device. It provides options for predetermined time durations, handles user interactions, manages notifications, and schedules alarms for timer expiration.

classes.name: SetTimerActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for setting timers on an Android wearable device. Handles user interactions, timer setup, notifications, and alarm scheduling.

classes.name: ListViewItem
classes.description: Model class representing a timer option with a label and duration.

classes.name: TimerWearableListViewAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for populating the wearable list view with timer options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, processes incoming intent extras for pre-set durations, or populates the list of timer options if no specific timer is provided.

methods.name: setupTimer
methods.description: Sets up a countdown timer, displays a notification, and schedules an alarm for expiration.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on the wearable list view to start a timer with the selected duration.

methods.name: registerWithAlarmManager
methods.description: Schedules an alarm with the Android AlarmManager to trigger when the timer expires.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Creates a notification with actions for restarting or deleting the timer, displayed while countdown is active.
